name: Create agent from dashboard
steps: Verify it appears in agent list
expected: Agent created successfully, appears in sidebar/agent list, chat opens with new agent

name: Create agent from template

Send a message to Agent A

Verify two-panel layout (config on left, preview on right or similar)
